//ConnectionStrings: Deliberately absent. This file is committed, and the development connection string carries a password, so it lives in .NET user secrets instead — see docs/postgres-setup-dev.md.
//Administrator: Also in user secrets: `dotnet user-secrets --project src/Homon.Api set Administrator:Email you@example.com` and the hash from `-- hash-password` under Administrator:PasswordHash.

FrontEnd.//: Empty in development: the Vite dev server proxies /api, so the browser sees one origin and CORS never engages. PublicBaseUrl is the Vite dev server itself — emailed links must land on the SPA, not on Kestrel.

Email.//: Development sends through Resend like every environment: a key typed into this database's Alerts page sends real mail, which is a deliberate act. To keep a machine from ever mailing anyone, set Email:Transport to Log in user secrets: `dotnet user-secrets --project src/Homon.Api set Email:Transport Log`.
